note: Test-data tiers from the development plan §8.1. Only 'tiny' data is committed; larger tiers are generated on demand with tests/fixtures/synthetic.py and never used as scientific results.

real.origin: measured 40nm CMOS digital PA, shipped with the package

synthetic.impairments: configurable delay / complex gain / clipping / outliers / NaN
synthetic.purpose: Dataset Doctor detector tolerances and fast state/numeric tests

standard.purpose: real-size import, diagnostics, chart and training flows

stress.storage: float32 I/Q binary (.npy), about 1.6 GB for input+output
stress.purpose: incremental reading and memory upper bound; not run per PR

history.generator: planned for S13: >= 1000 run summaries and 50000 log lines

doctor_protocol.note: Tolerances the Dataset Doctor must meet on tests/fixtures/synthetic.py captures (tests/unit/test_doctor.py). Changing them is a protocol change (protected).

clipping.impairment: clip_level at 60% of the unclipped output peak
clipping.clean_pa_must_not_flag: the memory-polynomial PA compresses smoothly; no clipping item on clean data
